Sports chiropractic, active-release, dry needling and progressive rehab for athletes and active people. We find the cause, fix it, and build you back to full speed.

We assess how you actually move under load and find the weak link — then load it, so the injury doesn’t come back.

children: Assess, treat, rebuild — the Kinetic method

From there it’s hands-on treatment to settle things down, then loaded, progressive rehab to build capacity back. That last step is what keeps you off the table and on the field.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Kinetic Spine & Sport is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: An open rehab floor with treatment tables and training space

children: We built Kinetic for the people other clinics send home with a heat pack and a shrug. Athletes, lifters, runners, weekend warriors — anyone whose life doesn’t stop when something tweaks.

It’s part treatment room, part training floor. We diagnose hard, treat hands-on, and load you back to full capacity — because getting out of pain and getting back to performance are two different jobs, and we do both.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every plan starts with how you move. We find the weak link before we touch the pain, so we fix the cause, not the symptom.
Active-release and dry needling to settle things down, then progressive rehab to build real capacity back.
We work to a target — a return-to-sport date, a lift, a race — not an open-ended schedule of maintenance visits.
